en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a large, monumental neoclassical/Beaux‑Arts style building with two tall corner towers facing a wide forecourt. The façade has evenly spaced vertical windows, ornate balconies, a central clock above the main entrance, and heraldic coats of arms or crests on the towers and above the entrance. Early automobiles and carriages are parked in front, and people gather near the main doors. A decorative metal fence and landscaped garden occupy the foreground.
